ICS 97.100.10ETD 32Revised Standard from Last Update.1. ScopeThis standard applies to electric direct-acting room heaters. They may be portable, stationary, fixed, or built-in.Notes — Example of the heaters covered in this standard are:a) Panel heaterb) Convector heaterc) Fan heaterd) Radiant heatere) Visibly glowing radiant heater It does not apply to:a) Thermal-storage room heaters;b) Heating appliances incorporated in the building structure;c) Central heating systems;d) Heaters connected to an air duct; ande) Wall-paper carpets or drapes incorporating flexible heating elements.This standard defines the main performance characteristics of direct-acting room heaters and specifies methods for measuring these characteristics, for the information of users.These performance requirements are additional to the safety requirements given in IS 302-2-30.2. ReferencesThe following standards are necessary adjunct to this standard.IS 302-2-30 (2007) Safety of household and similar elect r ical appl iances : Part 2 Particular requirements for room heatersIS 2500 (Part 1) : 2000 Sampling procedures for inspection by attributes : Part 1 Sampling schemes indexed by acceptance quality limit (AQL) for lot-by-lot inspection
